Be it ordained by the Mayor and Council of the Town of Chipley, that from and after the passage of this ordinance, it shall be construed as disorderiy for any person to discharge fireworks, of any description, within the town limits: and any person so doing shall be subject to a fine of not more than ($25.00) within discretion of the Mayor or Mayor Pro Tem, for each offense.

J. M. Layfield Recorder
